parameters.content:
## 1 · Website trigger
The public careers page sends JSON here. The webhook responds immediately so the browser does not wait for AI or recruiter approval.

After importing, activate the workflow and copy the **Production URL** from Receive Application.

## 2 · Credentials
Select an OpenAI credential in **OpenAI Chat Model**. Select the same Gmail credential in all three Gmail nodes.

## Audit guidance

- **Purpose:** retain a minimal record showing what the AI recommended and what the recruiter ultimately decided.
- **Audit Code nodes:** assemble a consistent record only after the applicant email succeeds.
- **Data Table nodes:** insert the record into **candidate_decisions**.
- **Stored fields:** application ID, role, AI score, AI recommendation, human decision, response time and execution ID.
- **Not stored here:** candidate name, email, CV text or skills.
- **Retention:** the separate **Candidate Audit Retention — 90 Days** workflow deletes records older than 90 days.
- Use the execution ID to trace an audit row back to its n8n execution when investigating an issue.

## What each node does

### Trigger & intake
- **Webhook** — receives the authenticated application from the careers website.
- **Validate Application** — verifies the proxy secret, required fields, consent, email and experience; then adds the role criteria.

### AI evidence assessment
- **Assess Candidate** — compares candidate-provided evidence with the must-have and nice-to-have criteria.
- **OpenAI Chat Model** — supplies the language model used for the assessment.
- **Structured Assessment** — forces the response into score, recommendation, summary, evidence, gaps and interview questions.
- **Validate Assessment** — clamps the score to 0–100, checks the recommendation and defaults incomplete output to REVIEW.

### Human decision
- **Recruiter Approval** — emails the review and waits up to 48 hours for the recruiter’s decision.
- **Approved?** — routes the recruiter’s Boolean response to invite or decline.

### Automated outcomes
- **Send Interview Invite** — emails the successful applicant.
- **Send Status Update** — emails the declined applicant.
- **Audit Invite Decision** — assembles the minimal INVITE audit record after the email succeeds.
- **Audit Decline Decision** — assembles the minimal DO_NOT_ADVANCE audit record after the email succeeds.
- **Store Invite Audit** — inserts the invite record into candidate_decisions.
- **Store Decline Audit** — inserts the decline record into candidate_decisions.

### Evidence-score interpretation
- **70–100:** strong evidence alignment; suggested ADVANCE.
- **50–69:** mixed or incomplete evidence; suggested REVIEW.
- **0–49:** insufficient evidence against core criteria; suggested DO_NOT_ADVANCE.
- The score summarizes application evidence only. It is not a hiring decision; the recruiter remains accountable for the outcome.

nodeGroups.name: 1 · Intake & Validation
nodeGroups.description: Validates the website submission, normalizes values and attaches the role-specific assessment criteria.

nodeGroups.name: 2 · AI Evidence Assessment
nodeGroups.description: Uses the language model and structured parser to produce a bounded, job-related evidence summary.

nodeGroups.name: 3 · Human Review
nodeGroups.description: Emails the recruiter, waits up to 48 hours for a decision, then routes the approved or declined outcome.

nodeGroups.name: 4A · Invite Outcome
nodeGroups.description: Sends the interview invitation and stores a minimal, durable audit record without candidate name or email.

nodeGroups.name: 4B · Decline Outcome
nodeGroups.description: Sends the status update and stores a minimal, durable audit record without candidate name or email.

nodeGroups.name: 5 · Audit Guidance
nodeGroups.description: Explains the durable decision record and the remaining retention-policy choice.
